roles.name: Chief Construction Officer
roles.description: Leads all construction operations and sets company-wide strategy.

roles.name: Vice President of Construction
roles.description: Oversees multiple projects and provides management support to construction teams.

roles.name: Construction Director
roles.description: Directs construction activity, timelines, and safety policies.

roles.name: Construction Manager
roles.description: Manages projects from initiation to completion, handling budgets, schedules, and compliance.

roles.name: Project Manager
roles.description: Plans, executes, and closes construction projects, managing teams and resources.

roles.name: Construction Superintendent
roles.description: Oversees daily operations on the construction site, ensuring schedule and quality.

roles.name: General Contractor
roles.description: Coordinates and oversees construction activities, manages subcontractors, and ensures completion.

roles.name: Construction Foreman
roles.description: Leads a crew of skilled tradespeople on site, reporting to the superintendent or project manager.

roles.name: Estimator
roles.description: Estimates project costs, materials, and labor requirements.

roles.name: Site Supervisor
roles.description: Supervises daily site operations and ensures safety compliance.

roles.name: Civil Engineer
roles.description: Designs, plans, and oversees construction and maintenance of building structures and infrastructure.

roles.name: Construction Architect
roles.description: Develops and manages project design, ensuring compliance with regulations.

roles.name: Skilled Tradesperson
roles.description: Executes specialized tasks such as carpentry, plumbing, or electrical work.

roles.name: Equipment Operator
roles.description: Operates heavy machinery such as cranes, bulldozers, and excavators.

roles.name: Construction Laborer
roles.description: Performs physical labor on construction sites, assisting skilled trades and supervisors.

roles.name: Apprentice
roles.description: Learns a specific trade under the supervision of skilled tradespeople.
